messages:
jess: Heads-up — opening a quick docs PR to clarify our fallback ceiling behavior for transient 429s/timeouts. Need consensus on wording + one tiny SDK snippet. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234
ben: moving to review. can you add a short explanation of the 'grace window' when we automatically route to a lower-capacity model? multiple product folks asked about token accounting.
rachel: +1. also include an example showing pattern: exponential backoff for retries, then immediate fallback to a smaller model if latency/SLO matters. maybe a compact code example.
sam: for SDKs, we prefer exposing a clear pattern. If we don't have a built-in `fallback_model` param, show a try/except + reconfigure approach. keep it idiomatic for py/js.
ben: infra note — call out cache implications: if KV/prefix cache is warm for the big model, falling back might lose caching benefits. also mention per-customer rate ceilings and short-term bursts.
jess: good call. should we call this "recommended runtime pattern" rather than a platform default? I don't want customers thinking Redwood auto-falls back without explicit config.
rachel: yes — recommended pattern. add a short bullet: "opt-in fallback policy" and link to routing doc. and I'll check billing: whether tokens consumed during a retry attempt are billed at the attempted model's rate or the eventual model's rate.
deploy-bot: PR #1234 created by jess and pushed to branch docs/fallback-ceiling. CI: docs lint OK, link-check pending.
sam: I'll draft two snippets and paste them in the PR: one Python (~8 lines) using try/except, one JS using async/await. Want them as inline examples in the page or separate code blocks under an "SDK snippets" section?
jess: inline for quick copy, separate files for full examples linked at bottom. keep the inline ones minimal.
ben: ops troubleshooting checklist idea: reproduce with a short load test, verify KV cache hit-rate, check model-selection logs for fallback events, and confirm quota billing in billing UI. can write a 3-line checklist.
rachel: ack — I'll send the billing confirmation by EOD and add the billing note to the PR. also will add a small table that maps symptom -> suggested action (e.g., repeated 429s -> increase concurrency limits / add cache).
jess: sweet. small ask: include one concrete command to reproduce a 429 locally (so support can triage). e.g.:
```bash
hey load -c 200 -n 500 "curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"big-llm\",\"input\":\"x\"}'"
```
keep it labeled as "synthetic repro".
sam: will inline a shorter JS snippet too.
deploy-bot: CI link-check passed. staging build deployed at 2026-03-22T14:05:12Z.
ben: one more: call out that fallback doesn't preserve server-side streaming in some cases — include a short note under limitations.
jess: great catch. I'll add a "Known limitations" bullet. thanks all — I'll merge after billing confirms token billing language. :thumbsup:
